## Design

### 2026-09-30 — # BRAINSTORM

**1.2h**

# BRAINSTORM
Okay now I know this part might be boring and yea it is. But this will lay the foundation of this warmup. Now here a little overview of what happened in the one hour and 20 minute-ish part of the "drawing"

+ Tried to truly think what should the project do?

+ What would be the audience for the project?

+ What is important now, as a FVP?

+ What makes it different from a typical mic (DJI mini mic for example), and what would make the software side different from just whisper plus AI

+ What should the workflow for the user be?

## What has been the issue?
In this hour, its important to know what you are competing against, because everyone could make an offbrand mic that connects with AI, but when it comes to beating what already exists? Oof is that hard. Not only do you have to know what the competition excels at, it also comes down to what you can do that is hard to replicate. As a 15 year old its hard to truly compete against a multi-million dollar company that has been ages in the market. But it is more fun to try to get better! From this I changed my perspective from. "A microphone that can transcribe your conversations" to "A personal mind archive", way cleaner in my opinion. This should give a different perspective to what I want to solve and how.
